parties: FRA 1397 - 141 - Le J c'est le S - Nicolas Trabuc
FRA 1397 - 141 - Le J c'est le S - Nicolas Trabuc
procedural_matters: The race committee was represented by Andre Boronat (race committee member on the pin-end finish vessel).
FRA 1397 was represented by Felix Leopold.
FRA 268 was represented by Yves Fretigny.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
Hearing No. 10 was heard together with hearing No. 6 in accordance with RRS 63.2(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were about 4-5 knots of wind and flat water.
FRA 268 and FRA 1397 were approaching the finish line on starboard tack, with FRA 268 clear ahead of FRA 1397 at the zone of the pin-end finish vessel.
After FRA 268 finished, and while being overlapped with the pin-end finish vessel, FRA 1397 established an inside overlap with her.
FRA 268 luffed, and immediately after FRA 1397 also luffed, and the hull of FRA 1397 touched the pin-end finish vessel halfway.
There was no contact between FRA 268 and FRA 1397.
There was no damage or injury.
conclusions: FRA 1397 not overlapped with FRA 268 and not in the zone at the time FRA 268 reached the zone, failed to give FRA 268 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(2).
FRA 1397 touched the pin end finish mark and broke RRS 31.
FRA 268 caused contact between FRA 1397 and the pin-end finish vessel, even though it was reasonably possible to avoid causing it, and broke RRS 14(c).
Since FRA 268 was sailing within the mark-room to which she was entitled and the contact did not cause damage or injury, she is exonerated under RRS 43.1(c) for breaking RRS 14.
